newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - AMR holds steady in light trading.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - AMR holds steady in light trading.

text.p: AMR Corp stock was trading at 82-1/4 after regular trading on Wednesday, even with its close, despite a late report that an analyst cut his 1997 earnings estimate for the company.
In general, there was not much activity after regular tradng hours, traders said.

Gruntal & Co analyst, Steve Lewins, cut his earnings estimate to $8.50 per share from $10.00 to reflect the cost of American Airlines' current labor woes. AMR opened Wednesday at 83-1/2 and was at 82-1/2 when the bell rang.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 80,900, compared to 45,100 on Tuesday. Session two volume was 1,561,000, while on Tuesday it was 2,238,707.
